name: King Family Vineyards
notes: A long lawn facing the mountains and one of Virginia’s best reds. Claim a table, order a bottle to share, and let the afternoon go long.

name: Afton Mountain Vineyards
notes: 360-degree mountain views and a lake, at one of Virginia’s first farm wineries. Take a lawn table, or the glass Pavilion when it’s chilly. Snacks from home are welcome.

name: Brewing Tree Beer Co
notes: Three minutes from the house. A beer for you, and a creek for the kids to splash in.

name: Veritas Vineyard and Winery
notes: A self-guided flight at your own table on a sunny deck facing the Blue Ridge, with lunch from The Terrace. The kitchen closes at 4:30, so go early.

name: Wintergreen Resort
notes: Skiing and tubing in winter, trails and golf the rest of the year.

name: Humpback Rocks
address: Trailhead: Humpback Gap parking area, Blue Ridge Parkway milepost 6
notes: A steep mile up to a wide view.

name: Blue Ridge Tunnel (east trailhead)
address: Trailhead: 215 Afton Depot Ln, Afton, VA 22920
notes: Walk under the mountain: an 1850s railroad tunnel, nearly a mile long and pitch dark. Bring headlamps. It’s cool and damp inside all year.
more: There is a second trailhead on the west side of the mountain, on the Waynesboro end, if you would rather start there.

name: Crabtree Falls
address: Trailhead: 11581 Crabtree Falls Hwy, Montebello, VA 24464
notes: One of the tallest sets of cascades east of the Mississippi. Bring boots.

name: Ravens Roost Overlook
notes: One of the best views on the northern Parkway: 180 degrees over the Shenandoah Valley from 3,200 feet. Go for sunset, and watch for the ravens.

name: Rockfish Gap (Blue Ridge Parkway, north entrance)
notes: The top of Afton Mountain. The Blue Ridge Parkway runs south from here and Skyline Drive runs north into Shenandoah National Park.

name: Charlottesville Downtown Mall
notes: About 35 minutes away. Dinner, a wander down the bricks, a rainy-day plan.

name: Pro Re Nata Brewery
notes: Halfway home on Route 250 in Crozet: a big lawn, a cold one and live music most weekends. The place to replay the game.

name: Wood Ridge Farm Brewery
notes: A farm brewery with play equipment for the kids and a driving range for whoever still has energy. Beer for the grown-ups.

name: Afton Overlook
notes: The first overlook on the Blue Ridge Parkway, a fifth of a mile in.

name: Rockfish Valley Overlook
notes: Parkway milepost 1.5. The valley the house sits in, from above.

name: Shenandoah Valley Overlook
notes: Parkway milepost 2.9, looking west.

name: Rock Point Overlook
notes: Parkway milepost 10.4.

name: Greenstone Overlook
notes: Parkway milepost 8.8, with a short self-guiding trail.

name: White Rock Falls
address: Trailhead: The Slacks Overlook, Blue Ridge Parkway milepost 19.9
notes: An out-and-back walk to a waterfall.

name: Turk Mountain
address: Trailhead: Turk Gap parking, Skyline Drive milepost 94 in Shenandoah National Park. The pin marks the summit
notes: Rock scrambles and a big view. Park entrance fee.

name: Dripping Rock
address: Trailhead: Dripping Rock parking area, Blue Ridge Parkway milepost 9.6
notes: Where the Appalachian Trail crosses the Parkway.

name: Rockfish Valley Trail
address: Trailhead: Spruce Creek Park, off Route 151 near Nellysford (pin is on the trail)
notes: Flat riverside walking in the valley. The main loop is about two miles.

name: Devils Backbone Basecamp Brewpub
notes: Their motto is “Drink Outdoors Together”: award-winning lagers, wood-fired food and a big meadow at the foot of the mountain. Built for trading ski and trail stories.

name: Hazy Mountain Vineyards & Brewery
notes: Come for the view: a glass on the hillside with the whole Blue Ridge laid out in front of you.

name: Twenty Minute Cliff Overlook
notes: Parkway milepost 19.

name: Three Ridges
address: Trailhead: Reeds Gap, where Route 664 meets the Blue Ridge Parkway near milepost 13.7 (pin is approximate)
notes: Wilderness ridges with a view south to The Priest. A long, hard day.

name: Paulie's Pig Out
notes: Barbecue.

name: Checkerberry Cabin
notes: American. At Wintergreen Resort; may be seasonal.

name: The Lookout
notes: Burger, sandwich. At Wintergreen Resort; may be seasonal.

name: The Edge
notes: Burger, regional. At Wintergreen Resort; may be seasonal.

name: Copper Mine Restaurant
notes: American. At Wintergreen Resort; may be seasonal.

name: Weasie's
notes: American.

name: Kline's Dairy Bar
notes: Ice cream.

name: Black Bear Creamery
notes: Ice cream.

name: Sweet Bliss Bakery
notes: Bakery.

name: Don Lupe
notes: Mexican.

name: Three Notch’d Nellysford
notes: Brewery, distillery and kitchen.

name: Calf Mountain
address: Trailhead: Beagle Gap, Skyline Drive, Shenandoah National Park
notes: Open meadows on the Appalachian Trail. Park entrance fee.

name: Mint Springs Valley Park
notes: A county park near Crozet with hillside trails.

name: Sherando Lake
address: Sherando Lake Recreation Area, George Washington National Forest
notes: A lake with a beach and trails in the national forest. Day-use fee.

name: Fortune’s Cove Preserve
address: Trailhead: Fortune’s Cove Ln, Lovingston, off Route 29
notes: A nature preserve with moderate to difficult trails.

name: Rockfish Valley Foundation Natural History Center
notes: A small natural history center beside the valley trails.

name: Old Trail Golf Club
notes: A public 18-hole course in Crozet at the base of the Blue Ridge, with practice facilities and a clubhouse.

name: Birdwood Golf Course
notes: The public course at Boar’s Head Resort: 18 championship holes, a six-hole par-3 course and a putting course.

name: Meadowcreek Golf Course
notes: A public course in the city of Charlottesville.

name: Glass Hollow Studios
notes: A glassblowing studio and gallery in Afton. Open Thursday to Sunday, 11 AM to 5 PM.

name: Giuseppes Italian Restaurant
notes: A restaurant in Nellysford.

name: Basic Necessities
notes: Wine and cheese night, sorted: pick up cheese, bread and a few bottles here, then take it all back to the porch.

name: Fardowners
notes: A restaurant in Crozet.

name: Restoration
notes: A restaurant in Crozet.

name: Smoked
notes: A restaurant in Crozet.

name: Duner's Restaurant
notes: The dinner on the drive home: an old-school Ivy favorite on Route 250 with a menu that changes daily. Book on game nights.

name: Pippin Hill Tasting Room
notes: The pretty lunch: a long table among the vines and gardens, with a glass that matches. Book ahead on weekends.

name: Michie Tavern
notes: A restaurant in Charlottesville.

name: Mockingbird
notes: A restaurant in Charlottesville.

name: Public Fish and Oyster
notes: A restaurant in Charlottesville.

name: Tavola Restaurant
notes: A restaurant in Charlottesville.

name: C&O Restaurant
notes: A restaurant in Charlottesville.

name: Zocalo
notes: A restaurant in Charlottesville.

name: Marigold by Jean-Georges
notes: The splurge dinner: Jean-Georges at Keswick Hall. Dress up, and pick a driver.

name: Chirios Pizza
notes: A pizza place in Nellysford.

name: Crozet Pizza
notes: Award-winning pizza since 1977, in a ramshackle red building that National Geographic’s travel guide once called home to “the best pizza in the world.” Call ahead for takeout.

name: Blue Ridge Pig
notes: A barbecue spot in Nellysford.

name: Graves Grocery & Deli
notes: A deli in Nellysford.

name: Bodo's Bagels
notes: A Charlottesville staple. Grab a bagel on the Corner before you walk to the stadium.

name: Trager Brothers Coffee 2.0
address: 190 Rockfish Valley School Lane Afton, VA 22920
notes: The closest coffee, three minutes from the house.

name: Belties
notes: Farmhouse café on Route 151: coffee, scratch biscuits and Belted Galloway cows.

name: Praha Bohemian Bakery and Cafe
notes: Our pick for bagels: honestly amazing, and worth the trip to Crozet.

name: Bryant’s Cider & Brewery
notes: A cidery in Roseland.

name: Virginia ABC
notes: The state liquor store in Nellysford.

name: Mountain & Vine Vineyards and Winery
notes: A winery in Covesville.

name: Loving Cup Winery
notes: A winery in North Garden.

name: Barren Ridge Winery
notes: A winery in Fishersville.

name: Blue Ridge Grocery IGA
notes: The main grocery run: the best and closest full grocery store to the house.

name: Greenwood Grocery
notes: Picnic stop: made-to-order sandwiches, local cheese, bread and wine for the porch or a winery lawn.

name: Harris Teeter
notes: The one big supermarket, in Crozet: a full stock-up on the way in.

name: Eventide Farm
notes: A farm market in Afton.

name: Nelson Farmer's Market Co
notes: The Nellysford farmers market. Seasonal, so check that it is running.

name: Saunders Brothers Farm Market
address: 2717 Tye Brook Highway Piney River, VA 22964
notes: A Route 151 farm stand worth the drive.

name: Ashley's Market & Deli
notes: The forgot-something stop, a minute from the house.

name: Afton Market
notes: A country store in Afton.

name: Rockfish Gap Country Store
notes: A country store in Afton.

name: CVS Pharmacy
notes: A local essential in Waynesboro.

name: Augusta Health Urgent Care
notes: A local essential in Fishersville.

name: Boar’s Head Resort
notes: A resort on the west side of Charlottesville, with a spa, restaurants and seasonal events open to visitors.

name: The Mill Room
notes: The dining room at Boar’s Head Resort, built around an old gristmill.

name: Iron and Ale
notes: The step up after a hot shower: a chef-driven bistro at Stoney Creek, at the foot of Wintergreen. Book ahead on ski weekends.

name: Monticello
notes: Thomas Jefferson’s mountaintop home. Make a day of it: the house in the morning, then lunch at Michie Tavern down the hill.

name: Trinacria Restaurant & Pizzeria
notes: A crowd favorite on Route 151: family-owned Italian and pizza. Eat in, or take it back to the house and relax.

name: The Spa at Keswick Hall
notes: The splurge: a massage or facial at Keswick Hall. Treatments include the steam room and infrared sauna. Book ahead.

name: Pad Thai
notes: Family-run, home-style Thai: curries, noodle bowls and drunken noodles.

name: The Roost Farm Shop
notes: A gourmet market and self-serve wine bar on Route 151, in a 1932 apple packing shed: local wine, beer, cheese and provisions.
